description: Classification matrix for routing clinician prompts to appropriate response templates

queryTypes.label: Initial Assessment Guidance
queryTypes.definition: How to approach a new cognitive concern with no prior workup or diagnosis
examplePrompts: I have a patient I'm worried about — where do I start?
My patient's behavior has changed over the last 6 months
Patient with memory problems, what should I do?

queryTypes.label: Diagnosis Process / Visit Structure
queryTypes.definition: Questions about how to structure the diagnostic visit, what to cover, in what order
examplePrompts: What should I cover in the first visit for cognitive concerns?
How do I structure a dementia evaluation visit?
What's the diagnostic pathway for this patient?

queryTypes.label: Workup Planning
queryTypes.definition: Ordering tests, labs, imaging — what to include and when
examplePrompts: What labs should I order for suspected dementia?
When should I order brain imaging?
What is the standard workup for cognitive decline?

queryTypes.label: Management
queryTypes.definition: General disease management, monitoring, caregiver support, referrals
examplePrompts: How should I follow up with this patient?
What community resources can I recommend?
How do I involve caregivers in management?

queryTypes.label: Safety Assessment
queryTypes.definition: Driving, living alone, medication management, fall risk, wandering
examplePrompts: Is it safe for this patient to drive?
How do I assess if this patient can live alone?
What safety concerns should I address?

queryTypes.label: Language Recommendation
queryTypes.definition: Sample phrases, communication strategies, how to phrase difficult conversations
examplePrompts: How do I tell a patient they have dementia?
What can I say to the family?
How do I bring up cognitive testing with a reluctant patient?

queryTypes.label: Conceptual / Educational / Standard Protocols
queryTypes.definition: General knowledge questions about dementia, syndromes, diagnostic criteria, staging, tools
examplePrompts: What is Lewy Body dementia?
How do I administer the MoCA?
What are the NIA-AA criteria for Alzheimer's?
What's the difference between MCI and dementia?

queryTypes.label: Differential Diagnosis
queryTypes.definition: Given specific findings, what conditions should be considered
examplePrompts: Could this be Parkinson's disease dementia?
Is this more likely Alzheimer's or vascular dementia?
What else could explain these symptoms?

queryTypes.label: Result Interpretation
queryTypes.definition: What a specific test score, lab value, or imaging finding means clinically
examplePrompts: What does a MoCA of 22 mean?
Is an MMSE of 24 concerning?
What do small vessel white matter changes indicate?

queryTypes.label: Referral Decision
queryTypes.definition: When to refer to neurology, geriatrics, psychiatry, or other specialists
examplePrompts: Should I refer this patient to neurology?
When should I involve a geriatrician?
Does this patient need neuropsych testing?

queryTypes.label: Therapeutics
queryTypes.definition: Medication decisions — starting, stopping, switching, dosing
examplePrompts: Should I start donepezil?
When should I discontinue cholinesterase inhibitors?
What are the contraindications for lecanemab?

queryTypes.label: Relational Challenges / Emotional Stuck Point
queryTypes.definition: Difficult family dynamics, patient denial, ethical dilemmas, caregiver burnout
examplePrompts: The family is in conflict about care decisions
My patient doesn't believe they have dementia
Is it okay to lie to protect my patient from the diagnosis?
The caregiver is exhausted and frustrated

queryTypes.label: Unrelated to Dementia
queryTypes.definition: Questions completely outside the scope of cognitive health and dementia care
examplePrompts: What's the best diet for diabetes?
How do I treat hypertension?
Can you help me with a dermatology question?

tier1Elements.label: Patient age
tier1Elements.description: Exact age or reasonable range (e.g., '70s', 'elderly patient')

tier1Elements.label: Presenting symptom(s)
tier1Elements.description: Cognitive, behavioral, or functional change described

tier1Elements.label: Duration and onset pattern
tier1Elements.description: How long symptoms have been present; gradual vs sudden; stable vs progressive

classificationPrompt.systemInstruction: You are a clinical query classifier for a dementia care support tool. Your task is to analyze clinician prompts and classify them according to the provided matrix. Output ONLY valid JSON matching the specified schema.

outputSchema.query_type_id: string (one of the defined query type IDs)
outputSchema.missing_elements: array of strings (optional, which tier1 elements are missing)
